records.label: Three unrelated Chinese men with MMAF

phenotypes.text: multiple morphological abnormalities of the sperm flagella

variants.as_reported: hemizygous missense variants in the X-linked CFAP47

quotes: identified hemizygous missense variants in the X-linked CFAP47 in three unrelated Chinese individuals with MMAF
Immunoblotting and immunofluorescence assays revealed obviously reduced levels of CFAP47 in spermatozoa from all three men harboring deleterious missense variants of CFAP47.
All men harboring hemizygous CFAP47 variants displayed typical MMAF phenotypes.

records.label: Australian severe asthenoteratozoospermic man(men) with Xp21.1 deletion

phenotypes.text: multiple morphological abnormalities of the sperm flagella

variants.as_reported: hemizygous Xp21.1 deletion removing the entire CFAP47 gene

quotes: WES data from an additional cohort of severe asthenoteratozoospermic men originating from Australia permitted the identification of a hemizygous Xp21.1 deletion removing the entire CFAP47 gene.
All men harboring hemizygous CFAP47 variants displayed typical MMAF phenotypes.

records.label: CFAP47-mutated MMAF man

phenotypes.text: multiple morphological abnormalities of the sperm flagella

quotes: we screened gene mutations in seven MMAF individuals and found two novel mutations in CFAP47 (c.706G>A, Val236Met; c.1337C>T, Thr446Met) in one case
Immunoblotting and immunofluorescence revealed that CFAP47 was dramatically reduced in spermatozoa from the CFAP47-mutated man.

notes.statement: Liao et al. (2022) found that CFAP47 interacted with WDR87 in the flagellar midpiece of mouse spermatozoa. WDR87 was highly expressed in human and mouse testis and localized to the middle piece of the sperm tail.
quotes: we identified a cilia- and flagella-associated protein, CFAP47, which interacted with WDR87 in the flagellar midpiece of the spermatozoa
These data indicate that WDR87 is located in the middle piece of the sperm tail and interacts with CFAP47 to form a complex which is involved in spermatozoa tail assembly.

notes.statement: In spermatozoa from an MMAF patient with CFAP47 mutations, Liao et al. (2022) found that WDR87 expression was significantly decreased, with weak signals next to the sperm nuclei. They suggested that CFAP47 is necessary for WDR87 transport during sperm flagella biogenesis.
quotes: Meanwhile, the expression of WDR87 was also significantly decreased, and weak signals were detected adjacent to the spermatozoa nuclei, indicating that CFAP47 was necessary for WDR87 transportation during spermatozoa flagella biogenesis.

notes.statement: Liu et al. (2021) reported that CFAP47 encodes a cilia- and flagella-associated protein that is highly expressed in testis.
quotes: CFAP47 encodes a cilia- and flagella-associated protein that is highly expressed in testis.

notes.statement: Liu et al. (2021) found that the 3 CFAP47 missense variants were absent from human control population genome databases. Multiple bioinformatic tools predicted them to be deleterious.
quotes: These three CFAP47 variants were absent in human control population genome databases and were predicted to be deleterious by multiple bioinformatic tools.

notes.statement: Liu et al. (2021) generated a Cfap47-mutated mouse model. Adult males were sterile and had reduced sperm motility and abnormal flagellar morphology and movement. Their fertility could be rescued with intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI).
quotes: We also generated a Cfap47-mutated mouse model, the adult males of which were sterile and presented with reduced sperm motility and abnormal flagellar morphology and movement.
However, fertility could be rescued by the use of intra-cytoplasmic sperm injections (ICSIs).

notes.statement: Liu et al. (2021) concluded that hemizygous mutations in CFAP47 can cause X-linked MMAF and asthenoteratozoospermia. By contrast, the MMAF genes identified previously showed autosomal recessive inheritance.
quotes: our experimental observations in humans and mice demonstrate that hemizygous mutations in CFAP47 can induce X-linked MMAF and asthenoteratozoospermia, for which good ICSI prognosis is suggested.

notes.statement: Liu et al. (2021) suggested a good prognosis with ICSI for CFAP47-associated asthenoteratozoospermia, based on rescue of fertility by ICSI in the mouse model.
